subtitle: 記錄一個因為下雨而待在家的日子
task: Write a diary entry about a rainy day you spent at home. What did you do, who were you with, and how did you feel at the end of the day?
taskZh: 寫一篇日記，記錄一個因為下雨而待在家的日子：你做了哪些事？和誰在一起？一天結束時有什麼感覺？
focus: 用過去式記錄一天發生的事
依時間順序寫：早上、下午、晚上

en: Today it rained all day, so I stayed at home. I did not have any plans, and at first I felt a little bored. I watched the rain on the window and listened to music.
In the afternoon, I decided to cook noodles with my younger brother. We made a big mess in the kitchen, but the noodles tasted great. After lunch, we played cards and laughed a lot.
In the evening, I read a book that I had bought months ago. It was a quiet day, but it was a good one. Sometimes a rainy day is exactly what I need.
zh: 今天下了一整天的雨，所以我待在家裡。我沒有任何計畫，一開始覺得有點無聊。我看著窗上的雨滴，一邊聽音樂。
下午，我決定和弟弟一起煮麵。我們把廚房弄得一團亂，但麵很好吃。吃完午餐後，我們玩撲克牌，笑得很開心。
晚上，我讀了一本幾個月前買的書。今天很安靜，卻是很美好的一天。有時候，下雨天正是我需要的。

patterns.zh: 一開始覺得……（為後面的心情轉變鋪路）
patterns.example: I did not have any plans, and at first I felt a little bored.

patterns.pattern: In the afternoon, I decided to …
patterns.zh: 用時間片語開頭，說明決定做的事
patterns.example: In the afternoon, I decided to cook noodles with my younger brother.

patterns.zh: 用 but 帶出出乎意料的好結果
patterns.example: We made a big mess in the kitchen, but the noodles tasted great.

patterns.pattern: Sometimes … is exactly what I need.
patterns.zh: 結尾：有時候……正是我需要的
patterns.example: Sometimes a rainy day is exactly what I need.

combine.answer: It rained all day, so I stayed at home.
It was a quiet day, but it was a good one.

paraphrase.sentence: At first I felt a little bored.
answers: In the beginning, I was a bit bored.
I was slightly bored at the start.
